mapper.select: SELECT dc.id, dc.name_cn, dc.name_en, dc.short_name_cn, dc.short_name_en, dc.region_code, dga.region_name AS areaName, dc.subregion_code, dga.subregion_name, dc.disabled, dp.id as partitionId, dp.code as partitionCode, dp.name as partitionName FROM dict_country dc LEFT JOIN dict_global_area dga ON dc.region_code=dga.id AND dga.is_deleted=FALSE LEFT JOIN cfg_country_partition CCP on ccp.country = dc.id and ccp.is_deleted = false and ccp.disabled = false left join dict_partition dp on dp.id = ccp.partition_id and dp.disabled = false and dp.is_deleted = false WHERE dc.is_deleted=FALSE ORDER BY dc.index DESC

SELECT dc.id, dc.name_cn, dc.name_en, dc.short_name_cn, dc.short_name_en, dc.region_code, dga.region_name AS areaName, dc.subregion_code, dga.subregion_name, dc.disabled FROM dict_country dc LEFT JOIN dict_global_area dga ON dc.region_code = dga.id WHERE dc.is_deleted = FALSE
and (dc.id ILIKE concat('%',#{params.searchKeyword}::text,'%') or dc.name_cn ILIKE concat('%',#{params.searchKeyword}::text,'%') or dc.name_en ILIKE concat('%',#{params.searchKeyword}::text,'%'))
and dc.name_cn in
#{item}
ORDER BY dc.index DESC

select id, name_cn, name_en, short_name_cn, short_name_en, region_code, disabled, subregion_code from ( SELECT dc.id, dc.name_cn, dc.name_en, dc.short_name_cn, dc.short_name_en, dc.region_code, dc.disabled, dc.subregion_code FROM dict_country dc WHERE dc.is_deleted = FALSE
and ((dc.id = #{params.searchKeyword}) or dc.name_cn ilike concat('%', #{params.searchKeyword}::text ,'%'))
order by
case when dc.name_cn ILIKE concat(#{params.searchKeyword}::text,'%') THEN 1 when dc.name_cn ILIKE concat('%',#{params.searchKeyword}::text) THEN 2 when dc.name_cn ILIKE concat('%',#{params.searchKeyword}::text,'%') THEN 3 end , dc.name_cn,
dc.id asc ) wls
